title: Privacy Policy
introDesc: Oblivions is a communication platform. This Privacy Policy explains how information is handled when you use the hosted service at msg.oblivions.ir, operated by TwelveII.
dataItem1: Account information: username, display name, and optionally your email address (used only for password recovery).
dataItem2: Messages: text messages you send in servers and direct messages are stored on our servers to deliver them to recipients. Where end-to-end encryption is enabled, we store only the encrypted form and cannot read the content. The one exception is reporting: when you report a message, its text (up to 500 characters) is sent to our moderation team together with the report, even in end-to-end encrypted conversations.
dataItem3: Files: images, videos, and other files you upload are stored on our servers for delivery.
dataItem4: Basic usage data: timestamps of account creation and last activity for operational purposes.
dataItem5: Push notification tokens: if you enable notifications on mobile, a device token issued by Apple or Google is stored to deliver them. It is removed when your account is deleted.
dataItem6: Signed-in devices: for each device you are signed in on, we store its type (for example "Windows · Desktop app"), the IP address it last connected from, the approximate city and country derived from that address, and when it was last active. This is shown to you under Settings → Security so you can recognise and sign out devices. The location is looked up on our own server using the DB-IP database; your address is not sent to any third party. This information is deleted as soon as the device signs out, is signed out, or goes 90 days without use.
dataItem7: Error reports: when the app hits an unexpected error, it sends us the error message, where in the app it happened, the app version and the platform (web, desktop, iOS or Android), so we can fix it. If you are signed in, the report is linked to your account so we can see who is affected. Before it is sent we remove tokens, email addresses, ids, the parameters of any link (the part that can carry a token) and your computer's user name in file paths, and we do not store your IP address with it. An error message can still contain a short piece of the data that caused it. Reports are deleted after 30 days.
dataUsageDesc: Your data is used solely to provide the service:
usageItem1: Deliver messages and files to their intended recipients.
usageItem2: Send password reset emails if you provided an email address.
noTrackingDesc: The service does not use cookies for tracking, analytics services, advertising networks, or user profiling. There are no third-party trackers embedded in Oblivions.
dataSharingDesc: We do not sell or rent your personal data. Certain service functions involve third-party infrastructure: push notifications may be delivered through Apple (APNs) and Google (FCM), and GIF searches are forwarded to the configured GIF provider without account identity attached.
selfHostDesc: If you configure your own LiveKit server, voice and video traffic uses that server. Other platform data, including accounts, messages, and uploaded files, continues to be handled by the Oblivions instance you are connected to. A separately operated full self-hosted instance has its own operator and privacy practices.
deletionDesc: You can delete your account in the app under Settings → Security. Your account is deactivated immediately and can be restored within a 30-day grace period by logging in again with your password. After 30 days, your profile information, uploaded files, push tokens, and personal data are permanently removed. Your messages are preserved for conversation continuity but displayed anonymously as "Deleted User". Direct message conversations remain visible to the other participant.
contactDesc: For privacy-related questions or requests, contact TwelveII through the in-app contact option. No public contact email is provided.
delIntro: You can request deletion of your Oblivions account directly in the app — no email is required.
delStep2: Open Settings and go to the Security section.
delStep3: Under Delete account, tap the delete button.
delStep4: Confirm the deletion in the dialog.
delData1: Deletion is permanent. You are signed out immediately, and the deletion completes after 30 days; until then you can cancel it by logging in again with your password.
delData2: After 30 days: your profile information, uploaded files, push notification tokens, and personal data are permanently deleted.
delData3: What is kept: your past messages remain for conversation continuity but are shown anonymously as "Deleted User". Direct message conversations remain visible to the other participant.
delPartialTitle: Delete some data without deleting your account
delPartialIntro: You can also remove individual pieces of data at any time, directly in the app:
delPartial1: Messages: delete any message you sent (hover over it and choose Delete on desktop, long-press on mobile). Deleted messages are permanently removed from the server, including any attached files.
delPartial2: Email address: your email is optional — you can remove it from your account under Settings → Security.
delPartial3: Profile data: your avatar, wallpaper, and profile details can be changed or removed under Settings at any time.
